identity.title: [Emergency] Recover and publish the 10 Medium launch article drafts to Google Drive

values.goal: Recover all ten existing ADL Medium launch article drafts and establish verified canonical copies in the approved company Drive folder.
values.required_outcome: The destination contains ten readable canonical drafts with preserved variants and a source-grounded digest manifest, without publication, sharing changes, destructive replacement, or synthetic prose.
declared_scope: Approved company Google Drive inventory and upload
Repository, Git history, and registered FastWork recovery search
Canonical revision selection and substantive variant preservation
authority_boundary: Issue #100 owns recovery and reconciliation only
The operator retains publication, sharing, deletion, overwrite, and synthetic-authoring authority
PR #98 and its ongoing review are outside scope
operator_constraints: Never write tracked work on main
Use only registered FastWork paths for issue work
Use the approved company Drive credential
Do not delete, overwrite, publish, or change sharing
Do not invent missing article prose
